ticket-003-characterize-double-alpha-env.notes: commit 75ff096. Guardian 5/5; clippy recount 175 unchanged; 484 passed/0 failed/2 ignored. KNOWN DEFECT F1 (spec design, Medium, accepted because ticket-011 replaces both tests): test 1 reduces algebraically to E_LP = correction_factor * min_k P_k (intended = alpha*min_k(P_k/alpha) = min_k P_k) and therefore PASSES after fix option (b) (remove scale_planes, keep cf=alpha, the plan recommendation); it FAILS only under option (a) (cf=1.0). Test 2 passes after bare (b) and fails after (a) or (b2) (b plus compute_fit_deviation on scaled planes; under b2 it fails at its FIRST assertion, not the one the doc comment cites). The doc comments claim "would fail if alpha were applied once" is true for (a) only. The "returned planes already carry alpha" half of the double-alpha claim is assumed by unscaled_pre_fix, not measured (no comparison against fit_hull_planes raw planes); it rests on code reading of pipeline.rs:85. F3 for ticket-011: its text "both of which fail once alpha is applied once" is wrong for test 1 under (b), and its replacement lp_envelope_matches_alpha_scaled_planes asserts E_LP == alpha*min_k P_k, which is also true pre-fix; the discrimination must come from its pipeline unit tests (fit_plant_returns_unscaled_planes, fit_plant_deviation_matches_alpha_scaled_envelope). Cheap optional fix offered by guardian: an independent pin recomputing raw hull planes via fit_hull_planes (discriminates (a) and (b)); not applied, needs user decision (ticket amendment). Notes for ticket-007 when copying section 5: tables print twice (tags applies_alpha_twice and reported_deviation, identical numbers; copy once); capture stderr alone with --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>file because stdout interleaving garbled a line; deviation columns are max_abs/mean_abs/rms in MW; ratio_min==ratio_max==alpha is algebraic, not a measured spread; FUNIL-GRANDE fit-grid deviation 0.000000 is genuine but zero by construction (fit nodes only; 11x11 max is 5.636 MW), ITUTINGA likewise (0.102 vs 2.229); the diagnostic does not uniformly overstate the error (CAMARGOS lp max 2.754 < reported 3.143 but lp mean 1.043 > 0.953; FURNAS max 21.078 < 25.361, mean/rms nearly equal); plane counts are after reduction and can change under (b) (CAMARGOS 6 to 7); alpha CAMARGOS 0.9696072573 FURNAS 0.9912951635, 30/10/10/30 qualifying nodes; tolerance 1e-9 has 6 orders of margin (max error 3.3e-16).
